Estimated (as if the crate had worked)

What happens with the time nobody was near the crate. Estimated collects as if the crate had worked the whole time. The game's World Item Removal List option deletes, when the area loads again, the dung left on the ground longer than the Hours for Removal List (24 h by default); only Estimated gives that production back.
Original (the dung composts in the composter's time)
Instant turns the dung into compost right away. Original puts the dung inside the composter, and the game composts it in its own time.
Instant only. With 2, 1 Cow Dung is worth 20%% compost instead of 10%%.
With 10, the crate uses the composters within 10 tiles of it, on the same floor.
To investigate problems: writes more details to the game console and the server log.
Collect and let crates compost them

Feathers pile up in the zones and have little use. With Collect and let crates compost them, the crate picks up the feathers, and each crate decides whether to turn them into compost: that starts off and, when on, each group of feathers (option below) is worth 1 Cow Dung when a composter has room.
With 100, every 100 feathers become 1 Cow Dung in the composter. A feather weighs almost nothing; the feathers are only used when a composter has room, so none is lost.
